primaryMatrix.description: Primary flows at 200 percent text in dark and light themes. Each destination and theme needs evidence for the version being released, from a device run or a reviewed baseline, with every check recorded as pass. There is no waiver; the gate stays red until the evidence exists.

evidence.notes: Reviewed baseline from ProductionRouteStateScreenshotTest. The section and switch summaries end in an ellipsis, and the diagnostics card titles break mid-word (troublesho / oting).

releaseRequirement: Run the automated accessibility test and record passing evidence for every primaryMatrix cell, which can't be waived. Then complete every manual scenario, or record an explicit release waiver with reason and owner.

AiWallpaper.reason: Full-flavor only and off by default, and it needs a user-supplied provider key, so it does not exist in the FOSS build at all.

Categories.reason: Static chip grid with no async state; the same chip components are already asserted on the wallpapers-grid surface.

Collections.reason: Needs populated collections in Room with cover previews, so the surface depends on database fixtures.

CommunityReports.reason: Admin-only moderation queue gated on a Firebase custom claim no test identity holds.

ContactPicker.reason: Requires the system contact picker and a granted contacts permission, so it cannot run without device interaction.

CreatorProfile.reason: Needs a live Firebase community identity and upload history, which the FOSS flavor does not build at all.

DeviceSounds.reason: Lists the sounds this phone's RingtoneManager reports and which one is set, so a device scenario needs real device media and the Modify system settings permission. The capture and restore rules are covered by SystemSoundWriterTest.

Downloads.reason: Lists real download history from Room and the file system, so a seeded scenario needs staged files on disk.

Favorites.reason: Superseded by Library as the bottom-nav destination; retained only so older saved state keeps resolving. Covered by the Library entry instead.

HiddenItems.reason: Lists this device's own hides from saved preferences. HiddenItemsContentUiTest renders it with seeded rows; a device scenario needs that preference fixture.

Library.reason: Renders the union of favorites, downloads and collections from Room, so a seeded scenario needs a populated database rather than a state object. Reachable and worth adding after Sounds.

Licenses.reason: Generated dependency-notice text with no interactive state beyond scrolling.

Onboarding.reason: Shows once on first launch and writes to DataStore, so exercising it needs a cleared install rather than a seeded route.

RotationHealth.reason: Reads live WorkManager state and battery-optimisation status, neither of which a JVM or seeded scenario can supply.

SoundEditor.reason: The waveform and trim controls only render after a real decode, so the surface cannot be seeded from a state object.

Sounds.reason: The feed needs a live YouTube search result to render anything, and ProductionRouteState has no seeded Sounds feed scenario yet. This is the largest untested screen in the app at 1,847 lines and is the first destination worth adding.

UniversalSearch.reason: Search results come from every provider at once, so a deterministic scenario needs all provider fakes wired together at once.

WallpaperCrop.reason: Gesture-driven crop surface whose state is a pinch-zoom matrix; assertions here need touch injection rather than a seeded state.

WallpaperDetail.reason: Covered end to end by the wallpapers-feed-detail manual scenario; a seeded scenario needs a full wallpaper plus vote and favourite state.

WallpaperHistory.reason: Reads applied-wallpaper history from Room, so it needs database fixtures rather than a state object.

WallpaperPreview.reason: Full-screen preview of an already-loaded bitmap with no controls of its own beyond a dismiss action.
